exposure: Distance between cervical internal os (CIO) and placental edge (PE)
distance between cervical internal os (CIO) and placental edge (PE)
cohort: 319 patients with placenta previa (PP) or LPI
finding: Complete PP and most placentas less than 1 cm from the CIO did not migrate, and this group had a significantly higher risk of hemorrhage at delivery, suggesting prophylactic cesarean section is warranted for CIO-PE distances <1 cm.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was the recommended mode of delivery for CIO-PE distances <1 cm due to the high risk of hemorrhage during vaginal delivery.
